test_cases.title: Information pages load with their expected heading for each page
acs: DERIVED: Each information page loads and shows its h1 - routes /ViewInformation.aspx, /Help.aspx, /About.aspx, /AccessibilityStatement.aspx, /PrivacyPolicy.aspx
assumptions: The local debug sign-in bypass is active, so the user is already signed in when the site opens.

Data set (route -> h1): /ViewInformation.aspx -> Information; /Help.aspx -> Help; /About.aspx -> About; /AccessibilityStatement.aspx -> Accessibility statement for the PT-LIMS website (the hyphen in PT-LIMS is U+2011, a non-breaking hyphen); /PrivacyPolicy.aspx -> VETQAS Privacy Notice.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/ViewInformation.aspx as a signed-in external user.
steps.expected: The page loads, the h1 reads Information and no server error page is shown.
The page loads, the h1 reads Help and no server error page is shown.
The page loads, the h1 reads About and no server error page is shown.
The page loads, the h1 reads Accessibility statement for the PT-LIMS website (with a non-breaking hyphen in PT-LIMS) and no server error page is shown.
The page loads, the h1 reads VETQAS Privacy Notice and no server error page is shown.

test_cases.title: Information pages keep their heading after the page is reloaded
acs: DERIVED: Each information page keeps its h1 after a reload and shows no server error page - routes /ViewInformation.aspx, /Help.aspx, /About.aspx, /AccessibilityStatement.aspx, /PrivacyPolicy.aspx
assumptions: The local debug sign-in bypass is active, so the user is already signed in when the site opens.

Data set (route -> h1): /ViewInformation.aspx -> Information; /Help.aspx -> Help; /About.aspx -> About; /AccessibilityStatement.aspx -> Accessibility statement for the PT-LIMS website; /PrivacyPolicy.aspx -> VETQAS Privacy Notice.
Reloading is a read-only GET and submits no data.

steps.expected: The h1 still reads Information and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/Help.aspx and reload the page.
steps.expected: The h1 still reads Help and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/About.aspx and reload the page.
steps.expected: The h1 still reads About and no server error page is shown.
The h1 still reads Accessibility statement for the PT-LIMS website and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/PrivacyPolicy.aspx and reload the page.
steps.expected: The h1 still reads VETQAS Privacy Notice and no server error page is shown.
